title: Monitoring Containers and Azure Kubernetes Service
description: Monitor containerized workloads with Container insights, Prometheus, and Grafana on AKS.

data.text: Container insights is a feature of Azure Monitor that collects performance metrics, inventory, and logs from AKS clusters and other container environments. It stores data in a Log Analytics workspace and provides pre-built dashboards for cluster health.

data.title: Enable Container Insights (Azure CLI)
data.content: Enable monitoring for an AKS cluster:
data.code:
az aks enable-addons \
  --resource-group myResourceGroup \
  --name myAKSCluster \
  --addons monitoring \
  --workspace-resource-id $(az monitor log-analytics workspace show -g myResourceGroup -n myWorkspace --query id -o tsv)

terms.definition: Azure Monitor feature for collecting container performance and health data.
An open-source monitoring system and time-series database, now natively supported by AKS.
An open-source analytics platform for visualizing Prometheus metrics.
A container resource usage and performance collector.

data.text: AKS includes managed Prometheus and Grafana through Azure Monitor. You can enable Prometheus metrics collection at cluster creation or on an existing cluster. Prometheus scrapes metrics from pods and nodes, while Grafana dashboards visualize them.

data.title: Enable Prometheus and Grafana (Azure CLI)
data.code:
az aks enable-addons \
  --resource-group myResourceGroup \
  --name myAKSCluster \
  --addons monitoring \
  --enable-msi-auth-for-monitoring true

az grafana create \
  --resource-group myResourceGroup \
  --name myGrafana \
  --location eastus

data.title: Use Container Insights Dashboards
data.text: Container Insights includes pre-built dashboards for cluster health, node performance, and live container view. Access them from the AKS resource in the Azure Portal under Insights.
